string.value: A legendary ring that improves along with its owner. Can be placed in storage and shared with other characters on the same account.

string.name: desc
string.value: A gift of gratitude given to you by the Legendary Black Dragon. Mystical powers surge through it.

string.name: desc
string.value: A ring that has not yet been evolved.\nIf you log in every day, get an item from Gaga, and play for an hour, you'll be able to upgrade the stats of the Evolving Ring III. On the last day of the event, an upgraded ring will become tradeable.
